item.title: Z.ai plan (GLM-4.7-plan) 模型一直出現 4054 錯誤
item.body:
## Bug Description
When using Z.ai plan provider with GLM-4.7-plan model in Trae IDE, 
all requests fail with error code 4054, in both SOLO Coder and Chat mode.

## Environment
- Trae Version: latest
- OS: Windows 11
- Provider: Z.ai plan (zai-plan)
- Model: GLM-4.7-plan
- Subscription: GLM Coding Lite (valid, active)

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Add custom model: Provider = Z.ai plan, Model = GLM-4.7-plan
2. Enter valid Z.ai API Key
3. Send any message in Chat or SOLO Coder mode
4. Error 4054 appears immediately

## Expected Behavior
GLM-4.7-plan should respond normally using the Coding Plan quota.

## Actual Behavior
Error 4054 on every request.

## Evidence
Direct API call via PowerShell works correctly:
- URL: https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions
- Result: Success, model glm-4.7 responds normally

But Trae's "Copy Request Info" shows a different token format:
.7622135720434369543:8fc960edbae9b8cc...

This suggests Trae is NOT passing the actual API Key to Z.ai,
but instead sending an internal request ID.

## Conclusion
The API Key itself is valid and working.
The issue is Trae not correctly forwarding the API Key to Z.ai plan endpoint.
